ExampleFile.description: A file an example assumes besides its page.

files.description: The project's other files the example assumes, in path order.

model.description:
The content model the example assumes, when the problem depends on
one: the example's own fragment, or else the explain model. `null`
when it's a problem under any content model.

MessageVariant.description: Another wording of a diagnostic's message.

message.description: The message, with its placeholders as written.

ascribe_version.description: The version of Ascribe that wrote it.

docs.description: The address of its entry in the diagnostics reference.

example.description:
A page that has the problem and the same page fixed; `null` when the
diagnostic has no example.

fix.description:
How to fix it, in general. `null` for a diagnostic that's no longer
reported.

level.description:
`file` for a problem found in each file on its own; `page` for one
found in each page as a build resolves it.

message.description: The message, with its placeholders (`{path}`) as written.

schema_version.description:
The version of this schema. It changes only when a field is removed
or changes meaning.

variants.description:
The other ways the message is worded, by the case they're for, in
name order.
